title: Wedjat eye-first museum corpus image eligibility audit before primary geometry execution
purpose: Prevent a frozen object ID from being treated as a single isolated eye image when the museum's primary displayed image is a multi-object plate or otherwise unsuitable for direct whole-frame geometry.
audit_method: Open each official Met object page first. Treat the museum object record as identity authority and the linked public-domain image as a separate measurement asset. No geometry is admitted merely because an object ID is in the frozen corpus.

confirmed_cases.note: Still requires exact source-byte SHA-256 sealing before primary measurement.

confirmed_cases.protocol_risk: Feeding the entire primary image into an eye-shape detector would measure a group of unrelated amulets and create a source-selection artifact.

confirmed_cases.note: Ornamentation/material style must be recorded because it can alter edge-based geometry relative to simpler amulets. Exact source-byte SHA-256 sealing still required.

important_protocol_correction.old_unsafe_assumption: One frozen museum object ID equals one directly measurable single-eye image.
important_protocol_correction.replacement_rule: OBJECT_IDENTITY and IMAGE_MEASUREMENT_ELIGIBILITY are separate gates.
important_protocol_correction.crop_rule: Cropping is allowed only after exact source bytes are sealed; crop coordinates and target-localization rationale must be recorded and cannot be tuned using dyadic or chronology outcomes.

relation_to_eye_first_lane.v0_5_orientation_model: Orientation must remain unmirrored during eligibility review.
relation_to_eye_first_lane.v0_6_full_eye_composition: Modern standardized-glyph control only; does not change museum-image eligibility.
relation_to_eye_first_lane.primary_priority: Build a clean, provenance-sealed eye-object corpus before returning to fraction magnitudes.

required: Retrieve exact official primary-image bytes for all frozen candidate object IDs where legally available.
SHA-256 seal each original image before crop or landmark scoring.
Assign one image-eligibility state without examining dyadic fit results.
For composite images, record immutable target bounding box after object identity localization.
Require enough single/localized eyes to satisfy the original minimum valid-object gate before any period trend is admitted.

highest_admissible_claim: The frozen twelve-object list remains a candidate object corpus, not yet a twelve-image measurement corpus. At least one frozen Met object, 546821, is presented in its primary linked image as a multi-object plate, so direct whole-frame geometry would be invalid. The protocol therefore requires a separate image-eligibility gate and immutable post-seal target localization before primary eye measurements.
